_comment: Live BannerHub Explore manifest. Uploaded as the 'bh_explore.json' asset on each STABLE release; the app fetches releases/latest/download/bh_explore.json, caches it, and falls back to the in-APK bundled copy offline. Edit this file (esp. the hero 'body' = What's New) when cutting a stable. Card actions: gog | url | article | soon. Rail types: hero | news | games | shortcuts.

cards.label: Features & What's New
cards.subtitle: Everything BannerHub adds to GameHub
cards.body:
WHAT'S NEW IN v1.6.0
• GOG integration — sign in and play your GOG library
• BannerHub Explore — our own offline discovery tab (this screen)
• Recording-compatible audio — screen recordings keep their game sound

EVERYTHING WE'VE ADDED
• No-login launch — straight to your library, no account needed
• Offline play for imported PC games (works in airplane mode)
• PC-accurate controller vibration & rumble, with per-game settings
• GPU spoof for better game compatibility
• Legacy GLES2 renderer toggle
• Strict per-game settings store
• PC Game Settings & Game ID menu rows
• BannerHub component catalog — drivers, DXVK, VKD3D, translators
• Custom BannerHub branding & app icon
• Muted UI click sounds

Tap below to view the project on GitHub.

cards.label: New Turnip R4 driver available
cards.body: A fresh Turnip R4 build is out with a One UI gralloc fix and a7xx performance work. Grab it from the in-app driver downloader.

cards.label: Dirt 3 now runs end-to-end
cards.body: Dirt 3 launches cleanly with DXVK 2.4.1 + Proton 9 arm64ec. Pin DXVK 2.4.1 to avoid the Turnip timeline-semaphore regression in 2.5+.

cards.label: GTA V
cards.body: Verified in airplane mode. DXVK 2.4.1, Proton 9 arm64ec, Turnip R4.

cards.label: DOOM
cards.body: Controller + audio confirmed with the proton10 arm64x xinput fix.

cards.label: Tomb Raider
cards.body: Solid with Zink renderer; try Vegas FrameGen for higher frame rates.

cards.label: Genshin
cards.body: Runs in the Genshin variant build.

cards.label: Recording-safe audio
cards.subtitle: Banner Tools → Audio
cards.body: Enable the recording-compatible audio toggle so MediaProjection captures game sound instead of silence.

cards.label: Pick a renderer
cards.subtitle: Zink works today
cards.body: The per-container Renderer dropdown lets you choose the GL backend. Zink is the shipped, working option.

cards.label: Frame generation
cards.subtitle: Vegas FrameGen
cards.body: Vegas FrameGen (GameHub AI Frame Gen) boosts perceived frame rate on supported titles.
